itineraries.title: Pittsboro Finally Friday: Line Dancing, Tiger Twilight Tour, Arts Walk
itineraries.theme: Small-town Chatham County Friday: a midday line-dance class, an adults-only twilight tour at Carolina Tiger Rescue, then the third-Friday arts walk and live piano at Chatham Mills
itineraries.drive_time: About 40 min from downtown Raleigh via US-64 W; Carolina Tiger Rescue is about 10 min north of downtown Pittsboro
itineraries.cost_range: Line dancing $25 per class (per listing text; record price unknown); tiger tour price not listed on the event (check carolinatigerrescue.org); arts walk free; about $40-$70 for meals
itineraries.overview: A hot, sunny Friday (89°F) with a Pittsboro anchor. Take the 11 AM line-dancing class at Forest Hall at Chatham Mills, lunch downtown, then rest through the afternoon heat. In late afternoon, take the adults-only Twilight Tour at Carolina Tiger Rescue. Finish on Hillsboro Street for the Finally Fridays Arts Walk and Mask Parade, with dinner and live piano at The Sycamore.

morning.title: Line Dancing Classes at Chatham Mills
morning.location: Forest Hall at Chatham Mills, 480 Hillsboro Street, Suite 350, Pittsboro, NC 27312
morning.notes: Every Friday, 11 AM-noon. The listing text says $25 per class; the record price is unknown. Check the Forest Hall event calendar.

afternoon.title: Twilight Tours at Carolina Tiger Rescue
afternoon.location: Carolina Tiger Rescue, 1940 Hanks Chapel Road, Pittsboro, NC 27312
afternoon.notes: 4:30-6:00 PM. Adults only (18+). Book ahead on carolinatigerrescue.org/tours; the price is not on the listing.

evening.title: Pittsboro Finally Fridays Arts Walk and Mask Parade
evening.notes: Runs 5-8 PM on Hillsboro Street and in the social district. The forecast is about 87°F when it starts.

evening.title: Pittsboro Gallery of Arts Celebrates 6 Years of Creativity in the Community
evening.location: Pittsboro Gallery of Arts, 44-A Hillsboro St., Pittsboro, NC 27312
evening.notes: Makers Celebration with art demos and refreshments, 5-8 PM. On the arts-walk route.

evening.title: Live Piano Music at The Sycamore
evening.location: The Sycamore at Chatham Mills, 480 Hillsboro Street, Suite 500, Pittsboro, NC 27312
evening.notes: Live piano 6-9 PM during dinner (see food).

food.notes: At Chatham Mills, beside The Sycamore (480 Hillsboro St). The co-op's own site says it is open daily 9am-7pm and its Co-op Cafe serves breakfast and lunch, with biscuits, croissants and muffins baked from scratch. The site names no specific dishes and gives no prices. No vegan or vegetarian dish was verified; ask at the counter.

food.vegan_dish: Tofu Bánh Mì (vegan with the sesame ginger vinaigrette, per menu)
food.notes: 89B Hillsboro St, Pittsboro NC 27312 (downtown). Own site: Fri 11:30am-11pm. Own food menu: Tofu Bánh Mì $10.75; the menu notes how to order it vegan. The Mediterranean $9.00. The menu has no V/VG labels, so these were classified from the listed ingredients; confirm with staff.

480 Hillsboro St, Suite 500, Pittsboro NC 27312. Own site: Fri 5-9pm, so a 7:45 PM seating leaves about an hour. Own dinner menu: Burrata & Basil Pesto $31 and Fall Salad (feta) $15 are meat-free by the listed ingredients. Grilled Broccolini & Asparagus $13, Lions Mane Mushroom Medley $14 and Crispy Delicata Squash $12 list no animal ingredients, but nothing is labeled vegan. The site says the menu is 'easily adaptable' for vegan eating. No vegan dish was verified; ask the server. Reservations recommended.

alternatives.good_weather: It will be hot (89°F). Rest in the shade at Chatham Mills, or browse the Save The Duck trunk shows downtown (Thistle and Oak, Dovecote; event ids 6abfe62a6042 / 37579355d5f0, prices not listed).
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast during the day. Use the same indoor shops.

alternatives.good_weather: Walk Hillsboro Street for the mask parade. Sunset is around 6:40 PM.
alternatives.rain: There is a slight chance of showers Friday night (22%). If it rains, stay indoors at the Pittsboro Gallery of Arts reception and The Sycamore.

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by about 10:10 AM for the 11 AM class (US-64 W to Pittsboro).
Chatham Mills (class, co-op, The Sycamore) is on Hillsboro St, about 0.5 mi north of the courthouse circle. Park once there and walk or drive the short hop downtown.
Carolina Tiger Rescue requires advance booking for tours and only admits adults. Book at https://carolinatigerrescue.org/tours/.
Arts walk info: https://www.pittsboroartswalk.org/october-16-2026-event-mask-parade. Line dancing: https://www.foresthallatchathammills.com/event-calendar/.
Drive back to Raleigh after dinner takes about 40 min.

itineraries.title: Hillsborough Saturday: Walking Tour, Artist Talk, Wine Fair, Mystery Dinner
itineraries.theme: Colonial-town history and local art, then a Roaring '20s murder-mystery dinner at The Colonial Inn
itineraries.drive_time: About 40 min from downtown Raleigh via I-40 W / I-85 S to exit 164; downtown Hillsborough is walkable
itineraries.cost_range: Walking tour about $10 (per one listing); gallery and artist talk free; wine tasting $7.25-$19.99; mystery dinner $100; about $15-$30 for breakfast and lunch
itineraries.overview: A cool, showery Saturday (45% chance of rain, high 64°F), so most of the day is indoors or a short walk from the car. Start with the guided walking tour from the Visitors Center and the 'There and Back' show at Hillsborough Gallery of Arts. After lunch, go to the gallery's 2 PM artist talk and the Weaver Street Market wine fair. End at The Colonial Inn for the WHUP 'Rip-Roaring Revenge' mystery dinner.

morning.title: THERE AND BACK
morning.location: Hillsborough Gallery of Arts, 121 N. Churton St., Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: Gallery show by three local artists, open 10 AM-6 PM.

morning.title: Historic Hillsborough Guided Tours 2026
morning.location: Hillsborough Visitors Center, 150 E King Street, Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: 10:30 AM-12:30 PM, outdoors. The price is not on this record; a duplicate listing (6792cec6b686) shows $10. Book via Zeffy.

afternoon.title: Artist Talk for "There and Back"
afternoon.location: Hillsborough Gallery of Arts, 121 N. Churton Street, Hillsborough, NC 27278
afternoon.notes: Bernadette Januska, Marcy Lansman and Ellie Snow talk about their work. Light refreshments.

afternoon.title: Wine Tasting Fair | Fall Wine Sale
afternoon.location: Weaver Street Market Hillsborough, 228 South Churton St, Hillsborough, NC 27278

evening.title: 'Rip-Roaring Revenge' Interactive Mystery Dinner Presented by WHUP
evening.location: The Colonial Inn, 153 W King St., Hillsborough, NC 27278
evening.notes: 5:30-9 PM, indoors. WHUP fundraiser: dinner, drinks and a Roaring '20s mystery. Tickets via Etix.

food.notes: 228 S Churton St, Hillsborough NC 27278. Own site: store open daily 7am-9pm; breakfast bar Sat-Sun 7am-noon. The breakfast items listed (oatmeal, cheese grits, morning wraps, biscuit and bagel sandwiches, brunch potatoes) have no dietary labels or prices. No vegan or vegetarian dish was verified; ask at the bar.

Same store. Own site: lunch/dinner hot bar Sat-Sun 12-7:30pm. This week's list includes Sesame Crunch Tofu, Red Lentil Dal, Chickpea Marsala, Pumpkin Soup and vegetable dumplings, but none is labeled vegan or vegetarian and availability varies by store. No dish was verified; ask staff (919-245-5050). A third-party listing says The Nomad (122 W King St) opens Sat 11am-2pm, but no own-site menu could be verified.

153 W King St, Hillsborough NC 27278. Dinner is included in the $100 ticket. The listing does not publish a menu or vegan/vegetarian options; ask the organizers (Hillsborough Community Media) when booking.

alternatives.good_weather: Take the 10:30 AM guided tour from the Visitors Center (2 hours, outdoors).
alternatives.rain: Replace the tour with The Great Collage Adventure w/ Kathy Burnside at Eno Arts Mill, 437 Dimmocks Mill Rd (10 AM-1 PM, $45, 18+, event d4dd4f90a25c, book on Humanitix).

alternatives.good_weather: Go to the Fall Nature Fun Day on the Eno at Confluence Natural Area, 4214 Highland Farm Rd (free, 12-4 PM, event e24bf70cc35e). It is about 10 min by car.
alternatives.rain: Stay downtown: browse the gallery show again and eat lunch indoors at Weaver Street Market.
The tasting table may move or shrink in rain. The sale wines are still on the shelves in the store.

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by about 9:15 AM for a 10 AM start.
Park once in downtown Hillsborough (Visitors Center lot on E King St, or the public lots off Churton St). Everything except the Eno nature day is within about 0.4 mi.

Booking links: walking tour https://www.zeffy.com/ticketing/3277bebb-5a4c-48ec-9a1e-0c4e287138b5; mystery dinner https://www.etix.com/ticket/p/37423287/rip-roaring-revenge-a-mystery-dinner-fundraiser-hillsborough-hillsborough-community-media.
BikeFest (event b9f6963fe4bb) also starts from the Visitors Center at 7:30 AM, so expect cyclists and busier parking early.
Saturday night will be about 44°F with a chance of showers. Bring a jacket for the walk back to the car after 9 PM.

itineraries.title: Carrboro & Chapel Hill Saturday: Market, Ackland, Poetry and Songwriters, PlayMakers
itineraries.theme: Two free Carrboro festivals (West End Poetry, Carrboro Songwriters), the Ackland, and an evening Pearl Cleage comedy at PlayMakers
itineraries.drive_time: About 35 min from downtown Raleigh via I-40 W to NC-54 / Raleigh Rd; Carrboro to Chapel Hill is about 5 min
itineraries.cost_range: Market, museum and festivals free; PlayMakers $20 (other listings show $20-$75); about $40-$70 for meals
itineraries.overview: A rainy-day plan with mostly indoor stops. Start early at the Carrboro Farmers' Market, then see the two free recent-acquisitions shows at the Ackland. Spend the afternoon at the West End Poetry Festival in the Century Center (indoors) and the Carrboro Songwriters Festival rounds at Speakeasy. Finish with dinner on East Franklin and PlayMakers' 'Angry, Raucous, & Shamelessly Gorgeous'.

morning.title: Carrboro Farmers' Market (Saturday)
morning.location: Carrboro Town Commons, 301 W Main St, Carrboro, NC 27510

morning.title: Care & Concern: Recent Acquisitions of Modern & Contemporary Art
morning.location: Ackland Art Museum, 101 South Columbia Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27599
morning.notes: Museum open 10 AM-5 PM. Continental Shift (African art acquisitions, event 884286b6c82c) is in the same building.

morning.title: Continental Shift: Recent Acquisitions of African Art
morning.location: Ackland Art Museum, 101 South Columbia Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27599

afternoon.title: West End Poetry Festival (Day 3)
afternoon.location: Century Center, 100 N. Greensboro St, Carrboro, NC 27510
afternoon.notes: Readings 12:30-7:30 PM, indoors, all ages. After-party and open mic at 8:15 PM.

afternoon.title: The Carrboro Songwriters Festival
afternoon.location: Speakeasy Theatre, 100 E Main St, Carrboro, NC 27510
afternoon.notes: Nashville-style songwriter rounds, 12-8 PM. Speakeasy is about one block from the Century Center.

evening.title: Angry, Raucous, & Shamelessly Gorgeous | Playmakers Repertory Company Play
evening.location: PlayMakers Repertory Company, 120 Country Club Rd, Chapel Hill, NC 27599-3235
evening.notes: Pearl Cleage comedy. Book on playmakersrep.org.

food.notes: 101 E Weaver St, Carrboro NC 27510, about 0.3 mi from the farmers market. Own site: open daily 7am-9pm; weekend breakfast bar items (oatmeal, cheese grits, morning wraps, biscuits) are listed without dietary labels or prices. No vegan or vegetarian dish was verified; ask staff. The market itself also has prepared-food vendors.

100 E Main St, Carrboro NC 27510, the same corner as Speakeasy. Own site: Sat 9am-2:30pm, breakfast and lunch 'while supplies last'. The daily menu is only on its Square online store, so no dish, label or price was verified. Ask staff about vegetarian options.

1800 E Franklin St #16 (EastGate Crossing), Chapel Hill NC 27514, about 2.5 mi / 8 min to PlayMakers. Own location page: Sat dinner 5-10pm, so eat at 5:30 PM. Own menus page: Fasolakia $10 is labeled Vegan; Gluten Free. Briam (SM $10 / LG $16) is also labeled Vegan; Gluten Free. Gigantes Plaki $9 and Spanakoryzo $10 are also labeled vegan.

alternatives.good_weather: After the market, walk the 38th Annual Sculpture in the Garden show at the NC Botanical Garden, 100 Old Mason Farm Rd (free, 9 AM-5 PM, event 914ba6327205).
alternatives.rain: Keep the market visit short and go to the Ackland when it opens at 10 AM.

alternatives.good_weather: Move between the Speakeasy rounds and the Tall Tales & Cheap Ales songwriter panel at 2 PM (free, event 558fa68dc2e9).
alternatives.rain: Stay indoors at the Century Center poetry readings. The songwriter rounds are listed as outdoor or partly outdoor.

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by about 7:20 AM for an 8 AM market arrival.
Park at the Carrboro Town Commons/Century Center lots. The farmers market, Century Center, Speakeasy, Neal's Deli and Weaver Street Market are all within about 0.3 mi.
The Ackland is on UNC's campus. Use the Rosemary Street decks or metered spots on Franklin St.
PlayMakers tickets: https://playmakersrep.org/show/angry-raucous-and-shamelessly-gorgeous/. Festival info: https://carrborosongs.com and http://www.WestEndPoetryFestival.com.
Saturday night will be about 44°F with a 32% chance of showers. Bring an umbrella and a jacket for the 35 min drive home.

itineraries.title: Durham Sunday: Lemur Quest, Duke Gardens Harvest Festival, Chamber Orchestra
itineraries.theme: Duke Lemur Center family quest, the free Harvest Festival at Sarah P. Duke Gardens, then Haydn with the Chamber Orchestra of the Triangle
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from downtown Raleigh via I-40 W / NC-147; Lemur Center to Duke Gardens about 10 min, Gardens to Carolina Theatre about 8 min
itineraries.cost_range: Lemur quest $23.18; Harvest Festival free; Chamber Orchestra ticket price unknown on the Carolina Theatre listing (a duplicate listing shows $50); about $40-$70 for meals
itineraries.overview: A cool Sunday with a slight chance of showers (17%) that clears by evening. Start at the Duke Lemur Center's family Adventure Quest. Lunch downtown, then go to the free Harvest Festival in the Charlotte Brody Discovery Garden at Duke Gardens. End at the Carolina Theatre's Fletcher Hall for 'The Roxelanne Effekt', a Haydn program by the Chamber Orchestra of the Triangle.

morning.title: Family Adventure: Duke Lemur Adventure Quest
morning.location: Duke Lemur Center, 3705 Erwin Road, Durham, NC 27705

afternoon.title: Harvest Festival
afternoon.location: Sarah P. Duke Gardens, 420 Anderson St, Durham, NC 27705
afternoon.notes: 1-4 PM in the Charlotte Brody Discovery Garden, outdoors.

afternoon.title: The Chamber Orchestra of the Triangle: The Roxelanne Effekt
afternoon.location: Carolina Theatre of Durham – Fletcher Hall, 309 West Morgan St, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: Haydn symphony movements. Price not on this listing; another listing of the same concert (c2ea8a81a0eb) shows $50. Book through the Carolina Theatre ticket link.

food.notes: 776 9th St, Durham NC 27705, about 2 mi / 7 min to the Lemur Center. Own site: Sat-Sun 7:00am-3:30pm. Veggie Breakfast Burrito $8.90 (scrambled eggs, cheese) and Veggie Southwest Grits $9.00 are meat-free by the listed ingredients; the menu has no dietary labels. No vegan dish was verified on its own menu. The Breakfast 'Soyrrito' uses soy sausage but includes eggs. Ask the kitchen.

112 W Main St, Durham NC 27701 (downtown), about 12 min from the Lemur Center and 7 min to Duke Gardens. Own hours page: open seven days, Sun 11am-9pm. The Spring 2026 menu PDF lists Chili-lime Glazed Cauliflower at $11, marked V (and V+ without the sauce). Chili Braised Jack Fruit appears to be marked GF, V+, but the PDF text layout makes its price ambiguous (possibly part of the $14 'Choice of Three'). Legend: V = vegetarian, V+ = vegan. Confirm with the server.

335 W Main St, Durham NC 27701, about 0.3 mi from the Carolina Theatre. Own site: Sun-Thu 5-10pm, so it works after the concert (about 5:30 PM). The dinner menu is posted only as images, which could not be read this week. Last week the menu marked Gobi Sukka (V) and Achari Paneer (Veg), but that was not re-verified, so no dish is listed. Ask the server.

alternatives.good_weather: Stay for the full 1-4 PM festival, then drive downtown at 3:05 PM.
alternatives.rain: Go to the Hot Wax on Tap drop-in candle-making session at Bright Black, 2020 Chapel Hill Rd, Ste 24 (Sundays 2-4 PM, indoors, price not listed, event b216739f1410). It is about 5 min from the Gardens.

alternatives.good_weather: Shop the For The Girls Vintage Market at Durham Central Park (free, 2:30-6:30 PM, outdoors, event 7739290ddb2c).
alternatives.rain: Baron Tymas and the Swingtet at Sharp Nine Gallery, 4608 Industry Ln (3 PM, indoors, price not listed, event 0fb4be229a3a).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:45 AM for breakfast at Elmo's, or by 9:20 AM if you skip breakfast and go straight to the 10 AM Lemur quest.
Duke Gardens visitor parking is the paid lot off Anderson St. Downtown, use the Durham Centre or Corcoran St decks for Luna, the Carolina Theatre and Viceroy.

Booking links: Lemur quest https://www.eventbrite.com/e/family-adventure-duke-lemur-adventure-quest-tickets-2001202948891; concert https://tickets.carolinatheatre.org/websales/pages/ticketsearchcriteria.aspx?evtinfo=1032625~05de892e-fe79-4e77-8f75-9f03e89f9235&.
Leave the Gardens by about 3:05 PM to be seated for the 3:30 PM concert.
Sunday night will be mostly clear and about 47°F.

itineraries.title: Cary Sunday: Brunch, Historic Walking Tour, Trampled by Turtles at Koka Booth
itineraries.theme: Downtown Cary brunch and history walk, an afternoon show at The Cary Theater, and an evening bluegrass-folk concert at Koka Booth Amphitheatre
itineraries.drive_time: About 20 min from downtown Raleigh via I-40 W / Walnut St to downtown Cary; downtown Cary to Koka Booth about 10 min via US-1 / Cary Pkwy
itineraries.cost_range: Walking tour $15; Cary Theater show price not listed; Trampled by Turtles $30; about $40-$70 for meals
itineraries.overview: Cool with a slight chance of showers by day (17%), then mostly clear for the outdoor evening show. Have brunch at Peck & Plume on Academy St, walk downtown Cary's history with Triangle Walking Tours at noon, catch the 3 PM screening at The Cary Theater, have an early dinner, then see Trampled by Turtles at Koka Booth Amphitheatre.

afternoon.title: Cary Downtown Historic Guided Walking Tour
afternoon.notes: 1 hour, outdoors. Book with Triangle Walking Tours.

afternoon.title: You Had to Be There
afternoon.location: The Cary Theater, 122 E. Chatham St., Cary, NC 27511
afternoon.notes: Indoor screening. Tickets via Etix; the price is not on the listing.

evening.title: Trampled by Turtles
evening.location: Koka Booth Amphitheatre, 8003 Regency Pkwy., Cary, NC 27513
evening.notes: Outdoor amphitheater. The forecast is mostly clear, about 61°F at showtime and falling to 47°F overnight.

food.notes: 301 S Academy St (The Mayton), Cary NC 27511, a 2-minute walk to the tour start. Own site: Sunday brunch 8am-2pm (no Sunday dinner). Brunch menu labels: Chilaquiles Verdes (NF, GF, V) $15, Peck & Plume Porridge (NF, V) $11, Avocado Toast (NF, V) $14. No brunch item is labeled VG (vegan). Book a 10:30 AM table.

901 W Morgan St, Raleigh NC 27603. This is in Raleigh, not Cary: about 12 mi / 20 min to Koka Booth via I-40. No Cary restaurant with a verifiable Sunday-dinner menu was found. Own site: Sun dinner 4:30-9pm, so eat at 4:30 and leave by 5:50 PM. Dinner menu: Mujaddara (VG, GFO) $19, Eggplant Tower (VEG, GF) $17; Chilled Sesame Noodles (VG) $12 is also listed.

alternatives.good_weather: Take the noon tour, or the 2 PM Andy's Downtown Cary Historic Walking Tour from Esteamed Coffee ($15, event 643eeb11ff93).
alternatives.rain: Skip the tour and spend the time at The Cary Theater. 'Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!' also plays there at 6 PM (event 77a97b80bd7c, price not listed).

alternatives.good_weather: Trampled by Turtles at Koka Booth, 6:30 PM.
alternatives.rain: The free Jazz'd Up Sundays: Kobie Watkins at the Downtown Cary Park pavilion is also outdoors (6:30 PM, event 39751d18138e). For a fully indoor evening, see 'Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!' at The Cary Theater at 6 PM.

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by about 10:05 AM for a 10:30 AM brunch.
Downtown Cary: park in the Downtown Cary Park / Academy St municipal lots. Peck & Plume, the tour start (114 S Academy) and The Cary Theater are all within about 0.2 mi.

Booking links: walking tour https://www.trianglewalkingtours.com/book-online?category=207ada13-29de-4868-acc1-e68111265890; Cary Theater https://www.etix.com/ticket/p/40858529/you-had-to-be-there-cary-the-cary-theater?partner_id=100; Trampled by Turtles https://www.boothamphitheatre.com/events/detail/trampled-by-turtles.
Koka Booth is a lawn amphitheater. Bring a jacket. Check boothamphitheatre.com for its chair and bag policy (not verified here).
The drive home from Koka Booth to downtown Raleigh takes about 20 min.

itineraries.title: Raleigh Wednesday: Gregg Museum, Science Demo, NCMA, Johnny Blue Skies
itineraries.theme: A sunny midweek museum crawl on free admission, a plant-based lunch, then Johnny Blue Skies & the Dark Clouds at Lenovo Center
itineraries.drive_time: 0-15 min within Raleigh: Gregg Museum to downtown about 10 min; NCMA to Lenovo Center about 5 min
itineraries.cost_range: Museums and demo free (Seeing Red price not listed); concert $54; about $45-$70 for meals
itineraries.overview: The best weather of the week: sunny, 72°F. See Bobby C. Martin's 'A Creek in Carolina' at NC State's Gregg Museum, eat a vegan lunch downtown, and catch the free 'Incredible Science' demo at the Museum of Natural Sciences. Spend the late afternoon at the NC Museum of Art and its park, have dinner at Irregardless, then go to the 7 PM Johnny Blue Skies show next door to the museum at Lenovo Center.

morning.title: A Creek in Carolina: Artworks by Bobby C. Martin
morning.location: Gregg Museum of Art & Design, 1903 Hillsborough St., Raleigh, NC 27607

afternoon.title: Incredible Science at N.C. Museum of Natural Sciences
afternoon.location: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences, 11 W. Jones St., Raleigh, NC 27601

afternoon.title: Seeing Red
afternoon.location: North Carolina Museum of Art, 2110 Blue Ridge Rd., Raleigh, NC 27607
afternoon.notes: Exhibition, 10 AM-5 PM. Ticket price not on the listing; check ncartmuseum.org.

evening.title: Johnny Blue Skies & the Dark Clouds
evening.location: Lenovo Center, 1400 Edwards Mill Rd., Raleigh, NC 27607

food.notes: 200 Park at North Hills St, Suite 101, Raleigh NC 27609, about 15 min to the Gregg Museum. Own locations page: 8am-8pm daily. Own menu: Big Green smoothie labeled (VG) and Açaí Bowl labeled (V). The menu page lists no prices.

421 Fayetteville St, Suite 103, Raleigh NC 27601, about 0.5 mi from the Natural Sciences museum. Own site: Mon-Thu 11am-9pm. The menu says it is 100% plant-based, so both dishes are vegan. Carolina BBQ $13, Elemental Burger $13.50. The weekday lunch deal (11am-2pm) adds kettle chips and a fountain soda to handhelds and burgers.

901 W Morgan St, Raleigh NC 27603, about 4 mi / 10 min to Lenovo Center via Wade Ave. Own site: Wed dinner 4:30-9pm, so eat at 5 PM and leave by 6:15. Dinner menu: Mujaddara (VG, GFO) $19, Eggplant Tower (VEG, GF) $17, Crispy Artichoke Hearts (VG, GF) $11.

alternatives.good_weather: Walk the NCMA Museum Park trails and outdoor art (sunny, 72°F) before or after Seeing Red.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast (2%). If it rains, take the NCMA Public Tour of the People's Collection at 1 PM instead of the science demo (free, West Building, event c5dd5a032796).

alternatives.good_weather: Johnny Blue Skies & the Dark Clouds at Lenovo Center, 7 PM.
alternatives.rain: Indoors either way. For a smaller show, see Lucía at NC State's Stewart Theatre, 7:30 PM ($10-$30, event 3708f1e9ddb5).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by about 8:45 AM for breakfast at North Hills, then the Gregg Museum at 10 AM.
Gregg Museum parking: NC State visitor parking near Pullen Rd / Hillsborough St (metered or pay-by-app). Downtown: use the Wilmington St or Jones St decks for Element and the Natural Sciences museum.
NCMA has free parking off Blue Ridge Rd. Lenovo Center event parking is across Edwards Mill Rd, about 5 min from NCMA.
Booking links: concert https://www.lenovocenter.com/events/detail/johnny-blue-skies; Seeing Red https://ncartmuseum.org/exhibition/seeing-red/.
Wednesday night will be mostly clear, about 51°F.
